text: ………　………　あの　おねがいが　あるんですが　きいて　もらえますか？

structure.jp: おねがいが　あるんですが
structure.en: I have a favor to ask, but

structure.jp: きいて　もらえますか？

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.span: きいて　もらえますか
patterns.explanation: もらう after a て-form verb means getting someone to do it for you; asking 'can I get' makes a polite request. きいて　もらえますか = 'could you hear me out?'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んです gives background the speaker wants you to know, and が trails off softly to lead into the request. あるんですが = 'the thing is, I have one, and...'.
